subject_group: 6.1.1 Preliminary steps in application of flying qualities

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that all Air Vehicle States have been defined for which safety of flight is to be assessed. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 4.1.3 Defining Air Vehicle States. For rotorcraft, the air vehicle meets standards within ADS-33-PRF, 3.1.6 Flight envelopes. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.
